q1.explanationZh: amateur 作名词“业余爱好者”，作形容词“业余的”，反义是 professional。

q2.explanationZh: amaze 及物动词“使惊奇”，主语通常是让人吃惊的事物。

q3.explanationZh: -ed 形容词 amazed 描述人的感受“感到吃惊的”，be amazed at。

q4.explanationZh: -ing 形容词 amazing 描述事物“令人惊奇的”。

q5.explanationZh: ambition 名词“志向；抱负”，形容词是 ambitious。

q6.explanationZh: ambition 去掉 -ion 加 -ious，构成形容词 ambitious“有抱负的”。

q7.explanationZh: ambulance“救护车”，call an ambulance“叫救护车”。

q8.explanationZh: America“美洲；美国”是专有名词，首字母大写；美国人是 American。

q9.explanationZh: amid 是介词，意为“在……之中”，如 amid applause“在掌声中”。

q10.explanationZh: among 用于三者或三者以上“在……之中”，两者之间用 between。

q11.explanationZh: amount 作名词“数量”，作不及物动词常用 amount to“总计达”。

q12.explanationZh: amuse 及物动词“逗乐”，名词 amusement“娱乐”。

q13.explanationZh: analyse 是英式拼写，analyze 是美式拼写，都是动词“分析”。

q14.explanationZh: analysis 是名词“分析”，复数是 analyses。

q16.explanationZh: anchor 名词“锚”，动词“抛锚；固定”，at anchor“停泊中”。

q17.explanationZh: ancient 形容词“古代的”，the ancients 指“古人”。

q18.explanationZh: and 是并列连词“和”，连接两个相同成分。

q19.explanationZh: anger 名词“愤怒”，也可作动词“激怒”；形容词是 angry。

q20.explanationZh: angle“角度”，注意与 angel“天使”拼写不同。

q21.explanationZh: angry 形容词“生气的”，be angry with sb.“生某人的气”。

q24.explanationZh: anniversary“周年纪念（日）”，注意双写 n。

q25.explanationZh: announce 及物动词“宣布”，注意双写 n。

q26.explanationZh: announce 加 -ment 构成名词 announcement“宣布；通告”。

q27.explanationZh: announce 加 -r 表示人，announcer“播音员”。

q28.explanationZh: annoy 及物动词“使恼怒”，be annoyed with sb.“生某人的气”。

q29.explanationZh: annual 形容词“每年的”，名词“年刊”，注意双写 n。

q30.explanationZh: another 泛指“另一个；再一个”，后接单数名词。

q31.explanationZh: answer 可作动词或名词“回答”，作动词时直接接宾语。

q32.explanationZh: ant“蚂蚁”，可数名词，复数 ants。

q33.explanationZh: Antarctica“南极洲”是专有名词，首字母大写。

q34.explanationZh: anticipate 及物动词“预料；期待”，可接 that 从句或动名词。

q35.explanationZh: 前缀 anti- 表示“反对；防止”，antipollution“防止污染”。

q36.explanationZh: antique 名词“古董”，形容词“古董的”，结尾是 -que。

q37.explanationZh: anxiety 是 anxious 的名词形式“焦虑；渴望”。

q38.explanationZh: anxious 形容词“焦虑的；渴望的”，be anxious about“担心”。

q39.explanationZh: any 多用于否定句、疑问句；用于肯定句时表示“任何一个”。

q40.explanationZh: an amateur in“从事……的爱好者”，介词用 in。

q41.explanationZh: an amateur of“……的爱好者”，介词用 of。

q42.explanationZh: a large amount of 后接不可数名词，表示“大量”。

q43.explanationZh: amount to“总计达到”，to 是介词，后接数量。

q44.explanationZh: ancient 作名词时，the ancients 表示“古人”。

q45.explanationZh: and so on“等等”，用于列举之后。

q46.explanationZh: anniversary 作定语，anniversary celebrations“周年庆典”。

accept: be annoyed with sb. at sth.

q47.explanationZh: be annoyed with sb.“生某人的气”，at sth. 表示“为某事”。

q48.explanationZh: annual 作名词“年刊”，a college annual“大学年刊”。

q49.explanationZh: one after another“一个接一个地；相继地”。

q51.explanationZh: answer for“对……负责”，介词用 for。

q52.explanationZh: answer 作及物动词，answer the phone“接电话”。

q53.explanationZh: be anxious about sth.“为某事担心”，介词用 about。

q54.explanationZh: be anxious to do sth.“渴望做某事”，后接不定式。

q55.explanationZh: be anxious about“为……担心”，be 后用形容词 anxious。

q56.explanationZh: 谚语 It is good to learn at another man’s cost.“前车之鉴”，another 修饰单数名词。

q57.explanationZh: 介词 with 后接名词，with anxiety“焦虑地”。

q58.explanationZh: What 引导的主语从句中缺谓语，“使烦恼”用 annoy，主语是单数且为一般现在时，用 annoys。

q59.explanationZh: 希腊语和拉丁语是“古代的”语言，形容词 ancient 修饰 languages。

q60.explanationZh: anger 作动词“激怒”，was angered by 是被动语态，用过去分词 angered。

q61.explanationZh: Some 后接可数名词复数，谓语 have 也说明主语是复数，用 animals。

q62.explanationZh: 与 facing 并列作介词 by 的宾语，用动名词 analyzing（英式拼写 analysing）。

q63.explanationZh: a moderate amount of“适量的”，amount 修饰不可数名词 coffee。

q64.explanationZh: “他们之中”指三者以上的范围，用介词 among。

q65.sampleAnswer: With the steadily decreasing amount of space for tree-planting in the city, urban residents should be encouraged to adopt a tree rather than plant one.
references: With the steadily decreasing amount of space for tree-planting in the city, urban residents should be encouraged to adopt a tree rather than plant one.
q65.rubricZh: 原书参考答案印作“With steadily decreasing amount of space for tree-planting in the city, urban residents should be encouraged to adopt a tree rather than plant one.”（steadily decreasing amount 前漏印冠词 the），经人工复核（GitHub #136）更正为现参考答案。

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “植树空间的数量”= amount of space；with + 名词短语表示伴随的背景；“认养而不是种植”= adopt rather than plant。

q66.sampleAnswer: We shouldn’t make friends with any dishonest persons.
references: We shouldn’t make friends with any dishonest persons.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: 否定句中用 any 表示“任何”；“和……交朋友”= make friends with。

q67.sampleAnswer: His ambition to win the Nobel Prize is not likely to be realized.
references: His ambition to win the Nobel Prize is not likely to be realized.
q67.rubricZh: 原书参考答案印作“His ambition to win Nobel Prize is not likely to be realized.”（Nobel Prize 前漏印 the），经人工复核（GitHub #136）更正为现参考答案。

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: ambition to do sth.“做某事的志向（愿望）”；“不大可能”= be not likely to；“实现”用被动 be realized。

q68.sampleAnswer: We held a grand party in celebration of our school’s fiftieth anniversary.
references: We held a grand party in celebration of our school’s fiftieth anniversary.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “成立 50 周年”= fiftieth anniversary，用序数词；“为了庆祝”= in celebration of。

q69.sampleAnswer: The maths teacher wonders if anyone knows the answer to the question.
references: The maths teacher wonders if anyone knows the answer to the question.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “……的答案”= the answer to，介词用 to；“想知道是否”= wonder if。

q70.sampleAnswer: This two-story hotel, whose antique charm is preserved, is located halfway up the mountain. Guests can easily reach the summit and visit the memorial hall at off-peak times.
references: This two-story hotel, whose antique charm is preserved, is located halfway up the mountain. Guests can easily reach the summit and visit the memorial hall at off-peak times.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: “古色古香”可译为 antique charm is preserved，用 whose 引导定语从句；“坐落于”= be located；“错峰”= at off-peak times。

q71.sampleAnswer: He was so busy looking for a job these days that he failed to pass the final exam, which annoyed his teacher.
references: He was so busy looking for a job these days that he failed to pass the final exam, which annoyed his teacher.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q71.explanationZh: “忙于做某事”= be busy doing；so...that 表结果；which 指代前面整件事，“使……生气”用 annoyed。

q72.sampleAnswer: When I worked as a volunteer in Africa, my relatives and friends were anxious for my safe return soon.
references: When I worked as a volunteer in Africa, my relatives and friends were anxious for my safe return soon.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q72.explanationZh: be anxious for sth.“盼望某事”；“平安归来”= safe return；叙述过去的事用过去时。

q73.sampleAnswer: Standing at the top of the mountain and looking as far as the eye can see, we are amazed at the magnificence of nature.
references: Standing at the top of the mountain and looking as far as the eye can see, we are amazed at the magnificence of nature.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q73.explanationZh: 人“感到惊叹”用 be amazed at；“站在……”“远望”用现在分词短语作状语，逻辑主语是 we。

q74.sampleAnswer: The project was originally intended to raise money to help those children who couldn’t afford to go to school, but for one reason or another, it was given up halfway.
references: The project was originally intended to raise money to help those children who couldn’t afford to go to school, but for one reason or another, it was given up halfway.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q74.explanationZh: “由于种种原因”= for one reason or another；“初衷是”= be originally intended to；“半途而废”= be given up halfway。
